❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a good Fog Index?

Below 12 is ideal for general audiences (high-school level). Technical writing often scores 14–18; anything above 18 is very hard to read.

What counts as a "complex word"?

A word with 3 or more syllables, excluding proper nouns (capitalized words) and words lengthened only by -es, -ed or -ing endings.

What is the formula?

Fog Index = 0.4 × ((words / sentences) + 100 × (complex words / words)).
